tax_litigation.status: The demand pertaining to Assessment Year 2018-19 was raised by the Assessing Officer vide order dated 21 September 2021. The Company has filed an appeal against the said order before the Commissioner of Income Tax (Appeals), which is currently pending adjudication.

The Maharashtra Sales Tax Tribunal (MSTT), vide its order dated 9 July 2025, quashed the MVAT and CST demands and directed the concerned authorities to recompute the demands in accordance with its order. The review/rectification application filed by the MVAT Department was subsequently dismissed by the MSTT vide order dated 4 May 2026, thereby upholding its earlier decision. The Department has filed a petition before the Bombay High Court on 24 August 2026 challenging the MSTT order. No further proceedings have taken place as at 30 September 2026.
